data.title: N Prisoners in Hats
data.solution:
import sys
import math

hats = []

n = int(input())
for i in range(n):
    h = int(input())
    hats.append(h)

def simulate_hat_game_fast(hats):
    n = len(hats)
    guesses = [None] * n
    
    # Total XOR of all hats seen by the last person
    total_front_xor = 0
    for i in range(n - 1):
        total_front_xor ^= hats[i]
    guesses[n - 1] = total_front_xor
    
    # Running XOR of hats that have been guessed by people behind
    running_guesses_xor = 0
    
    # Running XOR of hats that are in front of the current person
    # We can precalculate this or maintain it. Let's precalculate it in O(N)
    prefix_xor = [0] * n
    for i in range(1, n):
        prefix_xor[i] = prefix_xor[i - 1] ^ hats[i - 1]
        
    for i in range(n - 2, -1, -1):
        # Your hat = total_front_xor ^ prefix_xor[i] ^ running_guesses_xor
        guesses[i] = total_front_xor ^ prefix_xor[i] ^ running_guesses_xor
        running_guesses_xor ^= guesses[i]
        
    return guesses

print(simulate_hat_game_fast(hats))
data.statement:
<<Description>>
A warden lines up [[N]] prisoners in a single-file line. Each prisoner faces forward. Prisoner [[N]] is at the back of the line and can see everyone in front of them. Prisoner 1 is at the very front and can see no one.The warden places either a Black hat (1) or a White hat (0) on each prisoner's head. No prisoner can see their own hat.Starting from the back (Prisoner [[N]]) and moving to the front, each prisoner must guess the color of their own hat by shouting out either "Black" or "White".If a prisoner guesses correctly, they go free.If they guess wrong, they stay in prison.Every prisoner can hear the guesses of the people behind them.Before the game starts, the prisoners can meet to agree on a strategy.
<<Goal>>
Write an algorithm that acts as the strategy for the prisoners. Your strategy must save at least [[N]] - 1 prisoners.

Goal

Description
A warden lines up N prisoners in a single-file line. Each prisoner faces forward. Prisoner N is at the back of the line and can see everyone in front of them. Prisoner 1 is at the very front and can see no one.The warden places either a Black hat (1) or a White hat (0) on each prisoner's head. No prisoner can see their own hat.Starting from the back (Prisoner N) and moving to the front, each prisoner must guess the color of their own hat by shouting out either "Black" or "White".If a prisoner guesses correctly, they go free.If they guess wrong, they stay in prison.Every prisoner can hear the guesses of the people behind them.Before the game starts, the prisoners can meet to agree on a strategy.
Goal
Write an algorithm that acts as the strategy for the prisoners. Your strategy must save at least N - 1 prisoners.
Input
An array of integers hats of size N, where 1 represents a Black hat and 0 represents a White hat. The array is ordered from front to back (Index 0 is Prisoner 1, Index N-1 is Prisoner N.
Output
An array of guesses made by the prisoners, from Prisoner N down to Prisoner 1.
Constraints
3 <= N <= 1,000,000
Example
Input
3
1
0
1
Output
[1, 0, 1]
